question: Can oil's three physical information phases each own an appropriately scaled causal impulse clock while one continuous macro state distinguishes acceptance continuation from failed-auction reversal?

windows.validation_law: event and routed-entry counts only; no return, MFE, MAE, PnL, ranking, or selection

common_owner.transport_parity: same-suffix completed-five-minute MCL move must share the phase-local turn sign
common_owner.acceptance: phase-local turn agrees with continuous macro state
common_owner.failure: phase-local turn opposes continuous macro state
common_owner.position_count: one direction across phases; count only a routed direction change; every contract suffix starts flat

fixed_engine_law.cooldown_bars: equal to each profile-phase state bars
fixed_engine_law.phase_reset: new contract, Globex session, or physical phase identity

count_gates_each_profile_each_period.density: median 1-3, p95 <=6, maximum <=10 entries per active session

successor_law: Every count-qualified frozen profile may enter one separately preregistered discovery-first lifecycle. The lifecycle may rank no more than these three profiles using discovery after-cost stability; validation remains sealed until the winner passes all frozen discovery gates.
prohibitions: no phase-boundary, horizon, state, retrace, score, coherence, parity, or macro-state sweep
no time-of-day exclusion, quota, current-session long context, news, stop, target, timeout, or outcome-selected branch
no production refactor, order, or capital authority
